column2:
face(n./v.)臉、面對
facial(adj.)臉部的
face to face 面對面
face a problem 面對問題
She washes her face every morning.
(她每天早上洗臉。)
We must face the problem together.
(我們必須一起面對這個問題。)

fact(n.)事實
factual(adj.)事實的
in fact 事實上
a fun fact 有趣的事實
In fact, he is my cousin.
(事實上，他是我的表哥。)
It is a fact that the earth is round.
(地球是圓的，這是事實。)

factory(n.)工廠
(無詞性變化)
factory worker 工廠工人
car factory 汽車工廠
My uncle works in a car factory.
(我叔叔在一家汽車工廠工作。)
The factory makes toys for children.
(這家工廠生產兒童玩具。)

fail(v./n.)失敗、不及格
failure(n.)失敗
fail a test 考試不及格
fail to do 未能做到
He failed the math test last week.
(他上週數學考試不及格。)
Don't give up if you fail once.
(失敗一次也不要放棄。)

fall(n./v.)落下、跌倒、秋天
fallen(adj.)落下的
fall down 跌倒
fall asleep 睡著
The leaves fall from the trees in autumn.
(秋天樹葉從樹上落下。)
I fell asleep on the sofa.
(我在沙發上睡著了。)

family(n.)家庭、家人
(無詞性變化)
family member 家庭成員
family name 姓氏
There are four people in my family.
(我家有四個人。)
We have a family dinner every Sunday.
(我們每週日都有家庭聚餐。)

famous(adj.)有名的
fame(n.)名聲
be famous for 以……聞名
a famous singer 知名歌手
Taipei 101 is a famous building.
(台北101是一棟有名的建築。)
This town is famous for its tea.
(這個小鎮以茶聞名。)

fan(n./v.)風扇、粉絲、搧風
(無詞性變化)
electric fan 電風扇
a big fan of 是……的忠實粉絲
Please turn on the fan. It's hot.
(請打開電風扇，好熱。)
I am a big fan of that band.
(我是那個樂團的忠實粉絲。)

far(adv./adj.)遠的、遠地、非常
farther(adj./adv.)較遠的
far away 遙遠地
so far 到目前為止
My school is not far from my home.
(我的學校離我家不遠。)
So far, everything is going well.
(到目前為止一切順利。)

farm(n./v.)農場、耕種
farming(n.)農業、耕作
work on a farm 在農場工作
farm animals 農場動物
My grandparents live on a farm.
(我的祖父母住在農場。)
We saw cows and pigs on the farm.
(我們在農場看到牛和豬。)

farmer(n.)農夫
farm(n./v.)農場、耕種
rice farmer 稻農
local farmer 在地農民
The farmer gets up very early.
(這位農夫起得很早。)
We buy fresh fruit from local farmers.
(我們向在地農民買新鮮水果。)

fast(adv./adj.)快的、快速地
(無詞性變化)
fast food 速食
run fast 跑得快
He can run very fast.
(他可以跑得非常快。)
Don't eat too much fast food.
(不要吃太多速食。)

fat(n./adj.)肥胖的、脂肪
fatty(adj.)含脂肪的
get fat 變胖
low fat 低脂
My cat is getting fat.
(我的貓越來越胖了。)
This milk is low in fat.
(這種牛奶脂肪含量低。)

father(n.)父親
(無詞性變化)
Father's Day 父親節
like father, like son 有其父必有其子
My father cooks dinner on weekends.
(我爸爸週末會煮晚餐。)
We gave Dad a card on Father's Day.
(我們在父親節送爸爸一張卡片。)

feed(v./n.)餵食、飼料
(無詞性變化)
feed the dog 餵狗
feed on 以……為食
Can you feed the fish for me?
(你可以幫我餵魚嗎？)
Pandas feed on bamboo.
(貓熊以竹子為食。)

feel(v./n.)感覺、覺得、觸感
feeling(n.)感覺、感情
feel like 想要
feel better 感覺好些
I feel tired after school.
(放學後我覺得很累。)
Do you feel like going out tonight?
(你今晚想出去嗎？)

festival(n.)節日、慶典
festive(adj.)節慶的
Moon Festival 中秋節
music festival 音樂節
We eat mooncakes at the Moon Festival.
(我們在中秋節吃月餅。)
The music festival starts this Friday.
(音樂節這週五開始。)

few(adj./pron.)很少的、少數
fewer(adj.)較少的
a few 一些、幾個
quite a few 相當多
I have a few friends in Tainan.
(我在台南有幾個朋友。)
Few students were late today.
(今天很少學生遲到。)

fight(v./n.)打架、奮戰、爭吵
fighter(n.)戰士、鬥士
fight for 為……而戰
have a fight 吵架
The two boys had a fight at school.
(那兩個男孩在學校打了一架。)
We must fight for our dreams.
(我們必須為夢想奮鬥。)

file(n./v.)檔案、文件夾、歸檔
(無詞性變化)
save a file 儲存檔案
file folder 文件夾
Don't forget to save the file.
(別忘了儲存檔案。)
She put the papers in a file.
(她把文件放進資料夾。)

fill(v./n.)填滿、裝滿
full(adj.)滿的
fill in 填寫
fill up 裝滿
Please fill in this form.
(請填寫這張表格。)
He filled the bottle with water.
(他把瓶子裝滿水。)

finally(adv.)最後、終於
final(adj.)最後的
finally arrive 終於抵達
finally finish 終於完成
The bus finally came after an hour.
(公車等了一小時終於來了。)
I finally finished my homework.
(我終於寫完功課了。)

find(v./n.)找到、發現
finding(n.)發現、研究結果
find out 查明、發現
find it hard to 覺得……很難
I can't find my keys.
(我找不到我的鑰匙。)
Let's find out the answer together.
(我們一起找出答案吧。)

fine(adj./adv./v./n.)好的、晴朗的、罰款
(無詞性變化)
fine weather 好天氣
pay a fine 繳罰款
I'm fine, thank you.
(我很好，謝謝。)
He had to pay a fine for parking there.
(他因為在那裡停車而被罰款。)

finger(n./v.)手指、用手指觸摸
(無詞性變化)
cross my fingers 祈求好運
little finger 小指
She cut her finger with a knife.
(她被刀子割傷了手指。)
I'll keep my fingers crossed for you.
(我會為你祈求好運。)

finish(v./n.)完成、結束、終點
finished(adj.)完成的
finish homework 完成功課
finish line 終點線
Did you finish your dinner?
(你吃完晚餐了嗎？)
He was the first to cross the finish line.
(他第一個衝過終點線。)

fire(n./v.)火、火災、開除
fiery(adj.)火熱的
catch fire 著火
fire station 消防局
The house caught fire last night.
(那間房子昨晚失火了。)
Call 119 if you see a fire.
(如果看到火災請打119。)

first(n./adv./adj.)第一、首先、最初
firstly(adv.)首先
at first 起初
first of all 首先
At first, I didn't like the food.
(起初我不喜歡這個食物。)
First of all, wash your hands.
(首先，洗手。)

fish(n./v.)魚、釣魚
fishing(n.)釣魚、漁業
go fishing 去釣魚
fish market 魚市場
We went fishing by the river.
(我們去河邊釣魚。)
I don't like to eat fish.
(我不喜歡吃魚。)

floor(n./v.)地板、樓層
(無詞性變化)
on the floor 在地板上
first floor 一樓
My bag is on the floor.
(我的包包在地板上。)
Our classroom is on the third floor.
(我們的教室在三樓。)

flower(n./v.)花、開花
flowery(adj.)多花的、華麗的
flower shop 花店
a bunch of flowers 一束花
He gave his mom some flowers.
(他送媽媽一些花。)
The flowers in the park are beautiful.
(公園裡的花很漂亮。)

fly(v./n.)飛、搭飛機、蒼蠅
flight(n.)班機、飛行
fly a kite 放風箏
fly to 飛往
Birds can fly high in the sky.
(鳥能在天空高飛。)
We will fly to Tokyo next week.
(我們下週要飛去東京。)

follow(v.)跟隨、遵守、追蹤
follower(n.)追隨者、追蹤者
following(adj.)接下來的
follow the rules 遵守規則
follow me 跟我來
Please follow the school rules.
(請遵守校規。)
Follow me to the library.
(跟我到圖書館。)

food(n.)食物
(無詞性變化)
fast food 速食
junk food 垃圾食物
Taiwan is famous for its street food.
(台灣以街頭小吃聞名。)
Junk food is bad for your health.
(垃圾食物對健康有害。)

fool(n./v.)傻瓜、愚弄
foolish(adj.)愚蠢的
April Fool's Day 愚人節
make a fool of 愚弄
Don't be a fool.
(別當傻瓜。)
He tried to fool me on April Fool's Day.
(他在愚人節想捉弄我。)

foot(n./v.)腳、英尺、支付(帳單)
feet(n.)腳(複數)
on foot 步行
foot the bill 付帳
I go to school on foot.
(我走路上學。)
My left foot hurts.
(我的左腳很痛。)

for(prep./conj.)為了、給、因為
(無詞性變化)
for example 例如
for a while 一會兒
This gift is for you.
(這份禮物是給你的。)
I waited for him for an hour.
(我等了他一個小時。)

foreign(adj.)外國的
foreigner(n.)外國人
foreign language 外語
foreign country 外國
English is a foreign language for us.
(英文對我們來說是外語。)
She wants to study in a foreign country.
(她想去國外讀書。)

foreigner(n.)外國人
foreign(adj.)外國的
talk to a foreigner 和外國人交談
many foreigners 許多外國人
Many foreigners visit Taipei every year.
(每年有許多外國人到台北觀光。)
I helped a foreigner find the MRT station.
(我幫一位外國人找到捷運站。)

forget(v.)忘記
forgetful(adj.)健忘的
forget to do 忘記去做
never forget 永遠不會忘記
Don't forget to bring your book.
(別忘了帶你的書。)
I will never forget this trip.
(我永遠不會忘記這趟旅行。)

fork(n.)叉子、岔路
(無詞性變化)
knife and fork 刀叉
a fork in the road 岔路
Can I have a fork, please?
(可以給我一支叉子嗎？)
He eats noodles with a fork.
(他用叉子吃麵。)

free(adj./v./adv.)自由的、免費的、有空的、釋放
freedom(n.)自由
freely(adv.)自由地
free time 空閒時間
for free 免費
What do you do in your free time?
(你空閒時做什麼？)
The drinks are free today.
(今天飲料免費。)

fresh(adj.)新鮮的、清新的
freshly(adv.)剛剛、新近地
fresh air 新鮮空氣
fresh fruit 新鮮水果
Let's go out for some fresh air.
(我們出去呼吸新鮮空氣吧。)
The fish here is very fresh.
(這裡的魚很新鮮。)

friend(n.)朋友
friendship(n.)友誼
best friend 最好的朋友
make friends 交朋友
Amy is my best friend.
(艾美是我最好的朋友。)
It's easy for him to make friends.
(他很容易交到朋友。)

friendly(adj.)友善的
friend(n.)朋友
be friendly to 對……友善
eco-friendly 環保的
The people here are very friendly.
(這裡的人非常友善。)
She is always friendly to new students.
(她總是對新同學很友善。)

frog(n.)青蛙
(無詞性變化)
green frog 綠色青蛙
a frog jumps 青蛙跳
A frog jumped into the pond.
(一隻青蛙跳進池塘。)
We heard frogs singing at night.
(我們晚上聽到青蛙在叫。)

from(prep.)從、來自
(無詞性變化)
from A to B 從A到B
come from 來自
Where are you from?
(你從哪裡來？)
I walk from home to school.
(我從家裡走路到學校。)

front(adj./n.)前面(的)、正面
(無詞性變化)
in front of 在……前面
front door 前門
There is a tree in front of my house.
(我家前面有一棵樹。)
Please sit in the front row.
(請坐在第一排。)

fruit(n.)水果、成果
fruitful(adj.)富有成果的
fresh fruit 新鮮水果
fruit juice 果汁
Eat more fruit and vegetables.
(多吃蔬菜水果。)
Mangoes are my favorite fruit.
(芒果是我最喜歡的水果。)

full(adj.)滿的、吃飽的
fully(adv.)完全地
be full of 充滿
full name 全名
I'm full. I can't eat any more.
(我吃飽了，再也吃不下了。)
The bus is full of students.
(公車上擠滿了學生。)

fun(n.)樂趣、好玩
funny(adj.)好笑的
have fun 玩得開心
for fun 為了好玩
We had a lot of fun at the beach.
(我們在海邊玩得很開心。)
Learning English can be fun.
(學英文可以很有趣。)

funny(adj.)好笑的、奇怪的
fun(n.)樂趣
a funny story 好笑的故事
look funny 看起來很滑稽
He told us a funny story.
(他跟我們說了一個好笑的故事。)
That movie was really funny.
(那部電影真的很好笑。)

future(n./adj.)未來(的)、將來
(無詞性變化)
in the future 在未來
future plans 未來計畫
What do you want to be in the future?
(你將來想做什麼？)
Let's talk about our future plans.
(我們來談談未來的計畫。)

game(n.)遊戲、比賽
(無詞性變化)
play games 玩遊戲
video game 電玩遊戲
We won the basketball game.
(我們贏了籃球比賽。)
He plays video games after dinner.
(他晚餐後玩電玩。)

garden(n./v.)花園、園藝
gardener(n.)園丁
gardening(n.)園藝
flower garden 花園
in the garden 在花園裡
My mom grows roses in the garden.
(我媽媽在花園裡種玫瑰。)
The kids are playing in the garden.
(孩子們在花園裡玩。)

gate(n.)大門、登機門
(無詞性變化)
school gate 校門
boarding gate 登機門
Let's meet at the school gate.
(我們在校門口見。)
Our plane leaves from Gate 5.
(我們的飛機從5號登機門出發。)

get(v.)得到、變得、抵達
(無詞性變化)
get up 起床
get home 到家
I get up at six every day.
(我每天六點起床。)
It's getting cold outside.
(外面變冷了。)

ghost(n.)鬼、幽靈
ghostly(adj.)幽靈般的
ghost story 鬼故事
Ghost Month 鬼月
Do you believe in ghosts?
(你相信有鬼嗎？)
He likes to tell ghost stories at night.
(他喜歡在晚上講鬼故事。)

giant(adj./n.)巨大的、巨人
(無詞性變化)
giant panda 大貓熊
a giant tree 巨大的樹
We saw a giant panda at the zoo.
(我們在動物園看到大貓熊。)
The giant lived in a castle.
(那個巨人住在城堡裡。)

gift(n.)禮物、天賦
gifted(adj.)有天賦的
birthday gift 生日禮物
a gift for 對……的天賦
Thank you for the nice gift.
(謝謝你的好禮物。)
She has a gift for music.
(她有音樂天分。)

girl(n.)女孩
girlfriend(n.)女朋友
little girl 小女孩
girls' school 女校
The little girl is crying.
(那個小女孩在哭。)
There are twenty girls in our class.
(我們班上有二十個女生。)

give(v.)給、提供
(無詞性變化)
give up 放棄
give back 歸還
Please give me a pen.
(請給我一支筆。)
Never give up on your dreams.
(永遠不要放棄夢想。)

glad(adj.)高興的
gladly(adv.)樂意地
be glad to 很高興……
glad to hear 很高興聽到
I'm glad to see you again.
(很高興再次見到你。)
She was glad to hear the good news.
(她很高興聽到這個好消息。)

glass(n.)玻璃、玻璃杯
(無詞性變化)
a glass of water 一杯水
broken glass 碎玻璃
Can I have a glass of water?
(可以給我一杯水嗎？)
Be careful of the broken glass.
(小心碎玻璃。)

glasses(n.)眼鏡
glass(n.)玻璃、玻璃杯
wear glasses 戴眼鏡
a pair of glasses 一副眼鏡
My brother wears glasses.
(我哥哥戴眼鏡。)
I can't find my glasses.
(我找不到我的眼鏡。)

glove(n.)手套
gloves(n.)手套(複數)
a pair of gloves 一副手套
wear gloves 戴手套
Wear your gloves. It's cold.
(戴上手套，天氣很冷。)
I lost one of my gloves.
(我弄丟了一隻手套。)

go(v./n.)去、走、嘗試
(無詞性變化)
go to school 上學
have a go 試一試
I go to school by bus.
(我搭公車上學。)
Let's go to the park.
(我們去公園吧。)

god(n.)神、上帝
goddess(n.)女神
Oh my God 我的天啊
Greek gods 希臘眾神
Many people pray to God.
(許多人向上帝禱告。)
She looks like a goddess in that dress.
(她穿那件洋裝看起來像女神。)

good(adj./adv./n.)好的、擅長的、益處
goodness(n.)善良
be good at 擅長
good luck 祝好運
She is good at math.
(她數學很好。)
Good luck on your test!
(考試順利！)

goodbye(n.)再見、告別
bye(n.)再見(口語)
say goodbye 說再見
goodbye party 歡送會
It's time to say goodbye.
(該說再見了。)
We had a goodbye party for our teacher.
(我們為老師辦了歡送會。)

grade(n./v.)年級、成績、評分
(無詞性變化)
good grades 好成績
tenth grade 十年級
She always gets good grades.
(她總是拿到好成績。)
My sister is in the fifth grade.
(我妹妹讀五年級。)

grandfather(n.)祖父、外祖父
grandpa(n.)爺爺、外公(口語)
visit grandfather 探望祖父
my late grandfather 我已故的祖父
My grandfather is eighty years old.
(我爺爺八十歲了。)
I visit my grandfather every weekend.
(我每週末去探望爺爺。)

grandmother(n.)祖母、外祖母
grandma(n.)奶奶、外婆(口語)
live with grandmother 和祖母同住
grandmother's cooking 祖母的手藝
My grandmother makes great dumplings.
(我奶奶包的水餃很好吃。)
I live with my grandmother.
(我和外婆住在一起。)

grass(n.)草、草地
grassy(adj.)長滿草的
cut the grass 割草
green grass 綠草
The children are sitting on the grass.
(孩子們坐在草地上。)
My dad cuts the grass every Sunday.
(我爸爸每週日割草。)

gray(adj./n./v.)灰色(的)、變白
grey(adj./n.)灰色(英式拼法)
gray hair 白髮
gray sky 灰暗的天空
My grandpa has gray hair.
(我爺爺有白頭髮。)
The sky is gray today.
(今天天空灰濛濛的。)

great(adj./n.)很棒的、偉大的、大的
greatly(adv.)大大地
a great idea 好主意
a great man 偉人
That's a great idea!
(那是個好主意！)
We had a great time at the party.
(我們在派對上玩得很愉快。)

green(adj./n./v.)綠色(的)、環保的
(無詞性變化)
green tea 綠茶
green light 綠燈
Wait until the light turns green.
(等到變綠燈。)
I like green tea without sugar.
(我喜歡無糖綠茶。)
